what: Valid numeric dotenv settings caused database startup failure and prevented new routes from activating.
expected: Declared environment values supplied by dotenv or process.env are decoded before entering application code.
observed: Generated HTTP runtime returned string:7:string:false:false rather than number:7:boolean:false:true.
root_cause: packages/cli/src/commands/build-server-runtime-support.ts:125 skipped every resolved value already present in the raw source. As a result numeric and boolean values stayed strings and URL values stayed text, despite resolveEnv decoding them successfully. Database client Number.isInteger checks therefore rejected valid retention settings.
fixed_by: Always merge resolved declared values into the runtime environment, preserving undeclared source keys and validation failures. A real generated HTTP backend reproduces the original failure and passes after the one-line correction.

invariants: Supplied declared numbers, booleans and URLs match their declared runtime types.
Undeclared environment keys and defaults remain available.
Invalid and missing required environment still reject startup.

environment.target: Disposable built minimal application on a test-owned dynamic loopback port
environment.monitoring: Existing CLI structured logs and generated runtime lifecycle logs identified retention startup failure. The test uses actual buildProject, startProject, HTTP routing and application functions.

reproduction: Build a minimal app declaring a number, boolean and URL.
Start the emitted server with raw strings from environment source.
Request /hello/probe and assert decoded runtime types.
Run the same regression after correcting the generated environment merge.

before.note: Real HTTP response returned raw strings.
Declared 7 was returned as a string.

after.note: Real generated server decodes values; missing production secret still rejects.
Decoded values and invalid input boundary pass.

before.assertion: Declared number values supplied as text reach the runtime as numbers.

after.assertion: Numbers, booleans, URLs, defaults and undeclared values retain their contracts; invalid values still fail.

runtime.boundary: buildProject -> emitted server -> startProject -> HTTP route -> application function -> invocation env
dependencies: Actual compiler/config/runtime packages and Bun HTTP server; no external provider or mock environment parser.
steps: Start the generated backend on a dynamic port.
Assert /hello/probe body and join child shutdown.

before.assertion: Actual generated HTTP response contains number:7:boolean:false:true.

after.assertion: Actual generated HTTP response contains number:7:boolean:false:true and missing production environment is rejected.

e2e.assertion: Actual generated HTTP response contains number:7:boolean:false:true and missing production environment is rejected.

regressions.assertion: Actual generated HTTP response contains number:7:boolean:false:true and missing production environment is rejected.
regressions.boundary: Generated production server environment -> startup readiness

regressions.assertion: Numbers, booleans, URLs, defaults and undeclared values retain their contracts; invalid values still fail.
regressions.boundary: Emitted environment resolver -> actual Config resolveEnv

limitations: The existing installed logistic-platform-3 CLI process has not loaded the local source correction.
Full repository acceptance and package publication were not run.

notes: The user started Docker; MinIO is healthy. Current installed app remains on the previous generation until local fixes are adopted.
